metaDescription: View the Loom professional headshot package and test a one-time purchase with Creem.
title: A professional look, in one package.
description: A one-time package designed for a single person's professional profile: four portraits in one selected style, with one redo.
availability: This page records test payments and package entitlements. Photo upload, generation and downloads are not available yet. No real payment is collected.
productDescription: One package for one person, with no subscription or automatic renewal.
productBoundary: Designed for one person. Passport photos, identity documents, group photos and unlimited outfit changes are outside this package.
testDisclaimer: Test payment · No real charge. Creem hosts checkout and shows the test amount before you pay.
signInToPurchase: Sign in to test a purchase
signedIn: You are signed in. Purchases belong to this account.
signedOut: Sign in with Google or GitHub to save purchases to your account.
deliveryStatus: Package entitlements are saved after payment confirmation. This test does not produce or deliver photographs.
repeatPurchase: Each purchase creates a separate package. A full refund revokes only the package from that order.
emptyOrders: No orders yet. Your test purchases will appear here.
privateOrders: Sign in to view your orders. Only purchases belonging to your account are shown.
